verdict.rationale: Cake documents its own round-modelling capability: 'Model your raise and see how it affects dilution', and 'round modelling' is listed as part of the product. That covers the dilution part of the story. The documented raise workflow centres on SAFEs and convertible notes, and nothing shows priced-round-specific modelling or sharing a scenario with counsel or investors; investor communication is a separate feature, not scenario sharing. Missing for 10: option pool top-up modelling, SAFE conversion into a priced round, pro-forma ownership output, sharing modelled scenarios with counsel and investors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors

citations.quote: Model your raise and see how it affects dilution.
for those five you get the whole product: share classes, SAFEs, option grants, stakeholder portals and round modelling.
